How leads are sorted into Hot / Warm / Cold
  • Not counted: customers already at SHOW UP (they have visited) and EMPLOYEE contacts.
  • 🔥 Hot: the customer messaged us in the last 90 days and shows strong interest: they came back to ask again (returning / enquired again long after their first contact), or they are at NEW LEAD, POTENTIAL, APPT, POSTPONED, WINNER or WINNER PROJECT stage.
  • ☀️ Warm: the customer has replied to us within the last 12 months, but not as actively as Hot.
  • ❄️ Cold: no reply for more than 12 months, never replied at all, or marked DND / NOT INTERESTED / blocked.
  • Last Reply Date: the last time the customer sent us a message. Last Enquiry Date: the date the customer first came in to enquire (when the contact was created in Respond.io).
  • Last activity filter: uses the customer's own last message or enquiry, never a follow-up message sent by our team.
  • Click a customer to open their chat in Respond.io.
  • Inside each list, the most recently active leads are at the top, so work from the top down.
